_comment: Requirements registry: the single source of truth for requirement -> test traceability. Each requirement lists the test descriptions that cover it; those strings MUST exactly match the JUnit <testcase name> values (the 2nd argument to RUN_TEST in tests/*.c). tools/gen_dashboard.py joins these against the JUnit reports to compute coverage and warns on any mismatch (unknown test name, or test not mapped to any requirement). Update this file whenever requirements or tests change.

requirements.title: Capacity & bounds: count <= VMA_CAP and as_min <= as_max
tests: Boundary split is atomic at capacity (ENOMEM, no mutation)

requirements.title: Per-VMA validity: in-bounds, non-empty, page-aligned, prot within PROT_ALL
tests: Arithmetic guards: overflow detection & page rounding
Splitting a file-backed VMA advances file_offset correctly
mmap rejects invalid length/prot/alignment

requirements.title: Sorted & disjoint: vmas[k].end <= vmas[k+1].start for all k
tests: Primitive split/insert/remove keep ordering & count

requirements.title: Canonical form: no adjacent mergeable pair left unmerged
tests: VMA mergeability: prot/flags/backing & file-offset contiguity
Canonicalize merges adjacent compatible VMAs only
Anonymous mmap placement & adjacent merge

requirements.title: MAP_FIXED overlays the range: split boundaries, remove covered, insert new
tests: MAP_FIXED overlay splits the underlying reservation

requirements.title: Non-FIXED placement: honor a free in-bounds hint, else top-down first-fit
tests: Non-FIXED mmap honors a free hint, else first-fit

requirements.title: Reject length==0, prot/flags outside masks, and address/round-up overflow
tests: mmap rejects invalid length/prot/alignment
Arithmetic guards: overflow detection & page rounding

requirements.title: mprotect splits sub-ranges, sets prot, and rejects an unmapped gap (ENOMEM)
tests: mprotect splits sub-ranges & rejects unmapped gaps

requirements.title: munmap removes covered VMAs, tolerates already-unmapped sub-ranges
tests: munmap punches holes & tolerates empty ranges

requirements.title: Operations are all-or-nothing: at capacity, fail with ENOMEM and no mutation
tests: Boundary split is atomic at capacity (ENOMEM, no mutation)

requirements.title: Whole-object PROT_NONE reservation of the total image span
tests: Full ld.so mapping sequence preserves as_wf at each step

requirements.title: Per-PT_LOAD MAP_FIXED file-backed segment mapping with real prot (text R|X, data R|W)
tests: Full ld.so mapping sequence preserves as_wf at each step

requirements.title: bss zero-fill: anonymous R|W pages beyond file content via MAP_FIXED
tests: Full ld.so mapping sequence preserves as_wf at each step

requirements.title: GNU_RELRO: mprotect the relro sub-range of the data segment to read-only
tests: Full ld.so mapping sequence preserves as_wf at each step

requirements.title: Alignment-overshoot reservation: oversize PROT_NONE reservation, head/tail slack munmap trim to a p_align-aligned base, then baseline overlays
tests: Alignment-overshoot reservation trims slack to a 4P-aligned base

requirements.title: Multi-object load: each object carries a distinct map_id; adjacent VMAs from different objects never coalesce, even when prot/flags/backing match
tests: Multi-object load keeps a per-object map_id boundary (no coalesce)

requirements.title: dlclose-style teardown: mm_munmap_object removes every VMA of one object by map_id in one call, leaves other objects intact, and is idempotent on unused ids
tests: dlclose-style mm_munmap_object unloads one object by map_id (idempotent)

requirements.title: MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE places like MAP_FIXED but refuses (MM_EEXIST) to overlay an occupied range, mutating nothing; maps a free range exactly at addr
tests: MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE refuses overlap (EEXIST) but maps a free range

requirements.title: mremap shrink unmaps the tail and keeps the base address
tests: mremap shrink unmaps the tail and keeps the base

requirements.title: mremap grows in place into a free tail range, re-merging into one VMA (identity preserved); blocked grow without MREMAP_MAYMOVE returns ENOMEM with no mutation
tests: mremap grows in place into free space, re-merging to one VMA
mremap grow with no room and no MAYMOVE returns ENOMEM, no mutation

requirements.title: mremap grow with MREMAP_MAYMOVE relocates the mapping to a fresh region and frees the old range
tests: mremap grow with MREMAP_MAYMOVE relocates and frees the old range

requirements.title: mremap grow-in-place of a file-backed VMA preserves its file_offset and stays a single contiguous VMA
tests: mremap grow-in-place preserves a file-backed VMA's offset & contiguity

requirements.title: mremap requires the source to be exactly one whole VMA (sub-range -> MM_EINVAL); new_len == old_len is a no-op returning the original base
tests: mremap requires a whole VMA (EINVAL on sub-range) and no-ops equal sizes

requirements.title: munmap of a middle page splits a single VMA into a head and a tail VMA around the freed hole
tests: munmap of a middle page splits a single VMA into head and tail

requirements.title: mprotect that differs an inner sub-range then re-equalizes the whole range re-merges the splits into a single VMA
tests: mprotect differing then re-equalizing prots re-merges to one VMA

requirements.title: Non-FIXED placement returns MM_ENOMEM when no free hole is large enough for the request
tests: Non-FIXED mmap returns ENOMEM when no hole is large enough

requirements.title: MAP_FIXED whose range ends exactly at AS_MAX succeeds; a range exceeding AS_MAX returns MM_ENOMEM
tests: MAP_FIXED at the AS_MAX boundary succeeds; beyond it returns ENOMEM

requirements.title: A sub-page mmap length (e.g. 1 byte) rounds up so the VMA spans exactly one full page
tests: Sub-page mmap length rounds up to a single full page

requirements.title: File-backed VMAs carved from one mapping split (mprotect) and re-merge once re-equalized, confirming file_offset continuity across the boundary
tests: File-backed VMAs split then re-merge with continuous file_offset
